clue.text: Sweet and innocent girl's hugged by youth in charge

indicators.note: hugged by means the girl's word sits inside the youth's word, held in its arms

parts.note: a cub is a young person, as in cub reporter or a Cub Scout
the girl's things are hers; the possessive gives her

explanation.surface: A girl is being embraced by a young man who is running things, and she seems sweet and innocent.
explanation.definitionFit: Cherubs are pictured as chubby angelic children, so a cherubic face looks sweet and innocent.

clue.text: Controversial situation sees a couple of tomatoes added to stew

parts.note: a hotpot is a Lancashire stew of meat topped with sliced potatoes

indicators.note: a couple of picks the first two letters of the word tomatoes

explanation.surface: A cook adding tomatoes to a stew sparks a row in the kitchen.
explanation.walkthrough: A hotpot is a slow-cooked meat and potato stew from Lancashire in northern England.
explanation.definitionFit: An issue too contentious for anyone to want to handle is metaphorically too hot to hold.

clue.text: Free to admit the French must be annoyed

indicators.note: to admit means to let in, so the free's word lets the French article inside

parts.note: to rid is to free, as in rid of pests
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Releasing the French to let them in must be irritating.
explanation.definitionFit: Being irritated, vexed or angered is a synonym of annoyed.

clue.text: Formal dinner and drink without a place to sit

parts.note: a banquet is an elaborate formal dinner

indicators.note: without means the word for drink goes on lacking the letter a

parts.note: tea is a drink

explanation.surface: A formal dinner with a drink but nowhere to sit down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' takes A out of TEA, leaving TE.
explanation.definitionFit: This is an upholstered bench along a wall, as in a restaurant, so somewhere to sit.

clue.text: Smart, understanding part of clutch

parts.note: chic means smart or stylish
ken is understanding or knowledge, as in beyond my ken

explanation.surface: Smart understanding of how a car's clutch works.
explanation.walkthrough: 'clutch' suggests a car pedal or a handbag; it is a brood of eggs or chicks.
explanation.definitionFit: A clutch is a hatching of young birds, so each young bird is one member of it.

clue.text: Settle around end of year and hunker down

indicators.note: around means the settle's word wraps round the final letter that follows

parts.note: a settle is a wooden bench seat, much like a couch

indicators.note: end of picks the closing letter of the word year

explanation.surface: Instructions to settle in as the year closes and hunker down for winter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Settle' reads as a verb but is the noun: a high-backed wooden bench, here COUCH.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean to squat low with knees bent, drawing the body in close to the ground.

clue.text: Food needed by copper on right lines

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
RY, railway, stands for lines of track

explanation.surface: A police officer, a copper, wanting a meal while following the correct lines.
explanation.definitionFit: A spiced dish of meat or vegetables in sauce, one example of food.

clue.text: Vetoes laws subject to insurance starting late

indicators.note: subject to means the laws come beneath the trimmed insurance word in this down entry
starting late means the insurance word loses its opening letter

parts.note: cover is insurance protection
rules are laws

explanation.surface: Late-starting insurance policies are subject to laws that block them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'starting late' drops C from COVER; 'subject to' puts RULES under it in the down light.
explanation.definitionFit: To override a decision with higher authority is to veto or reject it.

clue.text: Carpenter beginning to chase joints

indicators.note: beginning to picks the first letter of the word chase

parts.note: hips are joints of the body

explanation.surface: A carpenter starting to cut chases in wooden joints.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Chips' is the traditional nickname for a ship's carpenter.
explanation.definitionFit: The ship's carpenter has long been known by this nickname from the wood shavings he makes.

clue.text: Hot line in forged notes

indicators.note: in means the line's letter is placed within the reworked letters of notes
forged notes are fakes, so the letters of notes are refashioned

explanation.surface: A tip-off that a hot line has been found among counterfeit banknotes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'forged' rearranges NOTES to STOEN, and 'in' puts L inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Hot is slang for illicitly obtained goods, freshly taken and risky to sell on.

clue.text: Former prime minister dismissing leader and southern Asians

indicators.note: dismissing leader means the first letter of the statesman's name is sent away

parts.note: Benjamin Disraeli was a British prime minister in the nineteenth century

explanation.surface: A former prime minister has fired his party leader and the southern contingent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dismissing leader' drops the D from DISRAELI, Victorian Britain's Conservative prime minister.
explanation.definitionFit: Citizens of the Middle Eastern state in western Asia are Asians by geography.

clue.text: The effect of giving up meat the day after Christmas?

definitions.meaning: the abrupt, unpleasant withdrawal symptoms of quitting a drug suddenly
the leftover festive bird, served chilled on Boxing Day

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the second, more playful reading: leftover poultry eaten cold on 26 December.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names sudden withdrawal from an addiction, and literally the chilled leftover Christmas bird.

clue.text: Right hand clenches when disregarding danger

indicators.note: clenches means the two outer letters grip the word for when between them

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'

explanation.surface: A right hand tightening into a fist at the very moment someone ignores danger.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting rashly means acting without thought for the risks, ignoring the danger involved.

clue.text: Rock band's first American season

indicators.note: first picks the opening letter of the word band

parts.note: to season food is to salt it

explanation.surface: A rock band's debut season touring America.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rock' sounds like music next to 'band' but it is the stone.
explanation.definitionFit: Basalt is a dark volcanic stone, a common example of igneous rock.

clue.text: Change the last word on workers in case of deficit

indicators.note: on means the last word sits on top of the rest in this down entry

parts.note: amen is said as the final word of a prayer

indicators.note: in means the workers are placed inside the outer letters
case of picks the outer letters of the word deficit

parts.note: men are workers

explanation.surface: A change, the final word on employees, put in because of a shortfall.
explanation.definitionFit: An alteration to a text, such as a law or a motion, is a formal change to it.

clue.text: Annoys son — that's uncalled- for!

parts.note: needles means provokes or annoys someone

explanation.surface: An exasperated parent protesting that a son's provocation was entirely unwarranted.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unnecessary and unwarranted, with no call for it, is uncalled-for.

clue.text: Exaggerate stitch

definitions.meaning: to embellish a story beyond the truth
to sew decorative needlework onto fabric

explanation.definitionFit: The word means to decorate cloth with needlework, and figuratively to embellish a tale.

clue.text: My ingress disturbed the effect of group action

indicators.note: disturbed means the letters are thrown out of their order

explanation.surface: Someone complaining that their entry upset a group's dynamic.
explanation.definitionFit: This term describes combined action producing an effect greater than the parts acting alone.

clue.text: Company present books as easy to understand

parts.note: to be present is to be here
NT, the New Testament, is a set of books of the Bible

explanation.surface: A publishing company presents its books as accessible reading.
explanation.definitionFit: Clear, logical and well-ordered speech or writing is readily understood.

clue.text: Food from kiln eaten by tribe, oddly

indicators.note: eaten by means the kiln word goes inside the letters that follow
oddly picks the first, third and fifth letters of the word tribe

parts.note: an oast is a kiln for drying hops

explanation.surface: A tribe oddly eating something baked in a kiln.
explanation.walkthrough: An oast house is the kiln used in Kent to dry hops for brewing.
explanation.definitionFit: A toasted sandwich is a snack, an example of food.

clue.text: Reserve must accept wrong grounding

indicators.note: must accept means the reserve's word takes the wrong's word inside it

parts.note: to bag a seat is to reserve it
a sin is a moral wrong

explanation.surface: A reserve player has to accept being wrongly grounded.
explanation.definitionFit: Basing and grounding both mean founding something on a foundation, as an argument on evidence.

clue.text: Slip made by small child

parts.note: a kid is a child

explanation.surface: A toddler takes a small tumble.
explanation.definitionFit: A skid is a sliding slip, as when tyres lose their grip on the road.

clue.text: Sikh — a kind wrapping cloth

indicators.note: wrapping means the words enclose the letters sought within them

explanation.surface: A Sikh, a kind man, wrapping himself in cloth, as with a turban.
explanation.definitionFit: This dull brownish-yellow fabric is the cloth of military uniforms.

clue.text: Make a world suitable for a flyer

indicators.note: suitable asks for the letters to be made fit, reworked into a fitting new order

explanation.surface: A grand ambition to create a world fit for something that flies.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suitable' rearranges the letters of MAKE A WORLD.
explanation.definitionFit: This North American songbird of open grassland is a bird, hence a flyer.

clue.text: Rodents can pick up last of rotten food

indicators.note: can pick up means the rodents take in the letter that follows

parts.note: mice are rodents

indicators.note: last of picks the final letter of the word rotten

explanation.surface: Mice nosing out the leftovers of rotting food.
explanation.definitionFit: Minced meat, finely ground beef, is a staple food.

clue.text: Time will be invested in genuine revolutionary in due course

indicators.note: invested in means put inside, so the time letter goes within
revolutionary means the word for genuine is turned round

parts.note: real means genuine

explanation.surface: Time spent backing a true revolutionary will pay off eventually.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionary' turns REAL into LAER, and 'will be invested in' puts T inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean at some point afterwards, eventually.

clue.text: Cob in mist looks nervous under this initially

parts.note: a haze is a light mist

indicators.note: initially picks the first letters of the four words before it

explanation.surface: A cob, a sturdy horse, peers through the fog looking jittery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cob' suggests a horse or swan, but here it is a kind of nut, the cobnut.
explanation.definitionFit: A cob, or cobnut, is a cultivated variety of the hazel tree's nut.

clue.text: Feature of group given task

definitions.meaning: a single item or particular aspect of something
a small squad of soldiers assigned to a particular duty

explanation.definitionFit: The word means a particular element, and in military use a small squad assigned a special duty.

clue.text: Hint to English — tread carefully!

parts.note: a tip is a hint or piece of advice

explanation.surface: A word of advice to an English visitor: watch your step!
explanation.definitionFit: Walking on the balls of the feet means moving quietly and cautiously.

clue.text: These will make sense as murder planned

indicators.note: a planned crime is carefully arranged, so these letters are arranged afresh

explanation.surface: A detective concluding that the clues only make sense if this was premeditated murder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'planned' rearranges AS MURDER; the sense in question is hearing.
explanation.definitionFit: These membranes in the ear vibrate with sound, enabling the sense of hearing.
